summary: The experiment found that merge_guard counted the request_fix job as not successful: that job is skipped on every green pipeline, so the guard held every merge request made after task_060 with the reason request_fix is skipped (merge requests !40 and !43, pipelines 2987028582 and 2987030591). The guard now ignores its auxiliary jobs, itself and request_fix, whatever their status; a real job that is skipped still holds the merge. 5 tests failed on the old code.
next: Ask the Developer Flow to bring main into !40 and !43 so their next pipeline runs the corrected guard and the guard merges them
